title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・暴虐女王！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka wins the race and becomes queen of the day! She gleefully exercises her royal command over Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finding the commands humiliating, Daiwa Scarlet flies into a rage.
